$comment: The landing page (D-174, D-176): visual first, a few words each. The hero, up to five featured sections, and the closing line; the tiles and the buttons are in the view document (packages/views/views/siteLanding.view.json). Each image is a desktop scene: the app's window (apps/desktop/e2e/site-catalog.spec.ts) on the wallpaper (tools/site/scenes.py), always in light mode; the Themes section offers the dark one behind a Light / Dark choice. WP-10.5 writes the final words.
headline: Write. Nothing else.
line: A calm writing app. Your notes stay plain files in your own GitHub.
